verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Langfuse is open source (MIT) and self-hostable via Docker Compose, Kubernetes Helm, and Terraform for AWS, Azure and GCP. Self-hosting runs the same infrastructure as Langfuse Cloud, and all core features are free without limitations. Only enterprise extras such as RBAC and audit logs need a license key. Independent users confirm running Langfuse OSS self-hosted for over a year and querying its database directly.
